description: This source file defines the PdfBooleanObject class, representing an indirect boolean value in a PDF document within the PdfSharp library. It includes constructors, a property to access the boolean value, and methods to output the object as a string or write it to a PDF writer.

classes.name: PdfBooleanObject
classes.description: Represents an indirect boolean value in a PDF document, with mechanisms for vector representation, string conversion, and writing to a PDF stream.
